work.title: Untitled (Layered Fragment Field)
work.description: Dense layered collage combines blue, red, and white paper fragments with inked line drawings of schematic faces, botanical forms, and angular cross-like red shapes overlaid across the picture plane. Multiple texture zones — hatched, painted, and photographic — create a fragmented patchwork ground with black ink gestures throughout.
work.composition: fragmented patchwork with diagonal red overlay
